02 | TIMELINE

MY STORY.

2019

It all started here.

Thanks to my sister, I was first introduced to video editing through Sony Vegas Pro. I remember working on a video for a big family day, and from that experience, I became passionate about learning more. Since then, I've explored the software extensively, mastering effects and the basics of video editing.

2021

The transition.

I wanted to expand my skills in design, motion graphics, and UI, so I started exploring Adobe products, which I find convenient and future-proof. With my basic knowledge, transitioning to these tools was smooth, and I picked them up quickly. Not only that, I also learned 3D using Blender and picked up more knowledge about storytelling.

2022

The real deal.

This is when the real journey began — I started working professionally after gaining enough confidence to promote myself. Luckily, I landed my first job with an emerging content creator while also taking on smaller projects independently under my own name.

2024

EZ Studio born.

I realised my name was gaining recognition in the industry, so I took the time to create my own professional brand — including a website, brand identity, and public promotion. This is where my journey as an independent studio began, and it continues to thrive today. One day, I will make my studio well known and potentially the best out there.

05 | CAREER

WORK EXPERIENCE.

  • Designed and developed 5+ creative stream overlays and assets for Twitch streamers, while also managing their streams—resulting in a 50% increase in concurrent viewers.
  • Served as a consultant for Havarri AKH Production, supporting social media promotion for their film and contributing to ideation for a drama series that became a hit in Malaysia.
  • Currently collaborating with Hikayat Fandom Publication as a long-term client, leading event asset design, social media content, and promotional media. Notably produced 3 book promotion videos showcased at the Asia International Book Fair in Beijing, China.
  • Collaborated with an emerging influencer, overseeing end-to-end creative production including pre-production, production, and post-production. Contributed to the account's growth, reaching nearly 20,000 followers.
  • Managed behind-the-scenes logistics such as equipment coordination, private tuition promotions, and partnership meetings. These responsibilities strengthened my independence, organizational skills, and exposure to corporate collaboration.
  • Strengthened teamwork and industry knowledge by handling multimedia needs across four departments, ensuring smooth B2B and B2C processes within a corporate environment.
  • Advanced UI/UX skills by developing a personal website that received highly positive feedback from both the manager and CTO, motivating continued skill growth in design and user experience.
  • Enhanced broadcast production expertise by managing end-to-end creative workflows for a live program with over 1,000 viewers. The event became the company’s most successful program to date.
